interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge or curb extensions to facilitate safe crossing between commercial destinations.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to move pedestrians past the visual obstruction of the rail columns and parked cars.

interventions.title: Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian-scale lighting attached to the underside of the rail structure to eliminate dark spots and improve nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corner to move pedestrians past the pillars for better visibility and to shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove the parking space closest to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Under-deck Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-oriented lighting on the underside of the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and improve safety.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder style to better alert drivers to the presence of the crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Enhance lighting under the elevated structure to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Consolidate street furniture and remove debris to ensure a clear, unobstructed walking zone for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.description: Install high-intensity LED lighting on the underside of the elevated structure to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Enhance lighting under the elevated structure specifically focused on the sidewalk and crossing areas to improve visibility and security.
